observedProblem: R06 validated WebMessageReceived source against trusted HTTPS origin but OnNavigationStarting only revoked the document epoch. It did not cancel WebView2 top-level navigation to external/unmapped origins; an untrusted document could be displayed inside the existing host despite its messages being rejected. Native Windows exploitation and UI appearance were not observed.
actualFix: Reused IsTrustedSource(args.Uri) on the existing CoreWebView2 NavigationStarting event. Any top-level navigation outside the pre-mapped local HTTPS virtual origin is cancelled with args.Cancel=true after revoking stale native work. The existing host, HOME/MENU/CORE, native consent, cancellation/backpressure and ACK behavior remain unchanged; no new host or external browser launcher is introduced.
